Subject: On‑prem version shelving & staggered cutover windows

Team / John —

We need to lock down the upgrade approach for AcmeHealth's on‑prem fleet (v1.8.2 -> v1.9.0). The two constraints they gave are: (1) strict audit window on May 20–22 (no disruptive changes), and (2) segregated networks where we can only do one rack at a time per datacenter.

Proposal (high level):
- Version shelving: pin active customer workload to a replica image (v1.8.2-hotfix) for the audit window, and stage a shadow rollout of v1.9.0 to canary racks only.
- Staggered cutover: sequential rack cutovers with 2hr validation holds between racks; primary rollback path is a fast config switch + KV cache invalidation.
- Preflight: run the attached staging checklist and the canary smoke tests (attached canary schedule).
- Rollback: deterministic scripts (sha listed in rollback-scripts-sha.txt) and a manual abort for any latency/regression > 15% RPS p50.

Requests: John — can Acme ops confirm which racks we can touch on May 18–19 for canaries? Internal owners — review the staging checklist and confirm owners for each validation step.

Attached: kp-staging-checklist-v1.pdf, canary-schedule-202705.csv, rollback-scripts-sha.txt

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Sr. PM, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Kimberly —

Thanks for the clear plan. We can open up Rack-11 and Rack-23 in our SJC DC for the canary window on May 18 between 02:00–06:00 PT. We cannot touch Rack-07 or Rack-09 because they host regulatory audit replay services.

A few clarifications: how long does the KV cache invalidation take for a single rack (ballpark)? Also, we need a fallback that does not depend on our internal orchestration (in case our orchestrator is degraded). Can you include a manual network isolate + traffic-shift procedure?

—John

Adding answers / owners:
- KV cache invalidation per rack (planned): ~4–6 minutes to drain and rehydrate under normal load; we will build the validation check that watches for the first 5 successful token responses. Owner: Monica.
- Manual fallback path: Dev — please prepare a conservative traffic shift using IPVS rules and the circuit breaker tag so Acme ops can flip at the L2/L3 level if their orchestrator is down.
- Validation owners: see checklist — I will own perf smoke, Monica will own correctness, Neha will own audit logs verification.

I'll stitch a short runbook excerpt into the staging checklist and push v1.1 by EOD.

Marissa

On Fri, May 14, 2027 at 12:10, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Adding answers / owners:
> 
> - Manual fallback path: Dev — please prepare a conservative traffic shift using IPVS rules and the circuit breaker tag so Acme ops can flip at the L2/L3 level if their orchestrator is down.

Quick update — I've committed a small helper (scripts/net-flip.sh) and an IPVS checklist to the runbook link. The helper supports two modes: 
1) warm-redirect (graceful): adjusts VIP weights over 5 minutes;
2) hard-isolate (emergency): withdraws instances from load balancer and forces static route to previous image.

I ran a dry run in staging yesterday: warm-redirect completed in 7 minutes (includes healthcheck retries), hard-isolate completes in ~90s. I included the script checksum in rollback-scripts-sha.txt.

I'll also add a small telemetry probe that emits a webhook when rehydration completes (helps automation decide to proceed to next rack).

—Dev
Dev Patel
Senior SRE, Runtime

- Audit window: we will apply a read‑only pin (v1.8.2-hotfix) for May 20–22; no cutovers during those dates.
- Communication: Monica please prepare the customer-facing maintenance advisory (short blurb, impact, contact, rollback SLA).
- Runbook: Marissa will publish staging-checklist v1.1 by EOD and include the net-flip usage and telemetry probes.

Action items (owners & ETA):
- Monica: maintenance advisory draft — 2027-05-17 17:00 PT
- Marissa: staging-checklist v1.1 published and link shared — 2027-05-17 18:30 PT
- Dev: include net-flip usage examples in runbook and update checksum file — 2027-05-17 16:00 PT

If no objections, I'll schedule the preflight dry run on May 17 09:00 PT and send the advisory to Acme's distribution list after Monica posts the draft.
